column_description: BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, uniquely identifying each environmental reading record.
CHAR(10) identifier for the monitoring device or sensor (e.g., 'MON000001').
TIMESTAMP NOT NULL indicating the date and time the reading was recorded.
CHAR(12) FOREIGN KEY referencing Showcases(ShowcaseReg), linking the reading to a specific showcase being monitored.
SMALLINT representing the measured temperature in Celsius.
REAL showing the 24-hour variation in temperature (in °C).
INT capturing the relative humidity percentage (0–100).
SMALLINT indicating the 24-hour variation in humidity (percentage points).
REAL specifying the measured air pressure in hectopascals (hPa).
